battle_boss1.png:
The boss arena of the LOWER TOWER (act 1) in a cat ninja tower game: a grand stone hall with a giant torii-like stone gate in the background, rows of flickering candles, hanging paper talismans, faint teal ghost-light in the air, worn stone floor with a large faded paw-print seal painted in the center.

IMPORTANT composition rules, same as the game's other battle backgrounds:
- Landscape 1280x720. The floor occupies the bottom third; characters will stand on it,
  so keep the bottom third relatively simple and flat, with the wall/scenery above.
- No creatures, no characters, no text, no watermark, no border.
- Style: thick painted shapes, flat colors with soft gradients, cute cartoon fantasy,
  not photorealistic. Slightly dark so bright characters pop.
Output 1280x720 PNG. Save the image as {ID} in the current directory and report the path.
